gpt-5.6-sol.freshness_disclosure: Promotional pricing verified on 2026-09-04; re-verify before later use.

provenance.method: Official model and pricing pages fetched by the recording coordinator. OpenAI rows are carried forward unchanged from the 2026-09-04 snapshot (per-model verified_on). Anthropic rows were read from the platform.claude.com pricing table on 2026-09-06.
provenance.cache_write_note: Anthropic bills prompt-cache writes separately: 5-minute writes at 1.25x and 1-hour writes at 2x the base input rate. cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h are USD per million tokens. OpenAI rows have no cache-write charge, so those keys are absent.
provenance.context_threshold_note: implementation_max_input_tokens (128,000) is the default conservative per-call input boundary. A model may override it with max_standard_input_tokens when its official pricing page states standard pricing across a larger context: Anthropic prices Claude 4.6+ models at standard rates across the full 1M window; Claude Haiku 4.5 has a 200K window. These overrides are implementation support boundaries mirrored from official pages, not independent pricing claims.
provenance.notice: These rates estimate equivalent API prices only. They do not represent ChatGPT subscription billing, Claude subscription billing, or usage-credit consumption.
